scope: Chat import parsing, personal-history consistency, isolated ZIP parser robustness
method: Synthetic fixtures only. KBLearning parser/history tests run through Swift package. Exact ZipReader enum extracted from production source and compiled in a temporary standalone macOS subprocess; no app crash or user archive involved.

findings.evidence: Valid 131-byte ZIP returns synthetic control. Malformed 68-byte ZIP with central-directory filename length 4096 terminates isolated parser process with -5 and Array index is out of range.
findings.cause: Central header length is checked but filename slice p+46..<p+46+nlen is used before checking its upper bound.

findings.evidence: All three supported-format Ben messages yield an empty message list.
findings.cause: Any body starting with < or containing omitted / dahil edilmedi is discarded, not just an exact media placeholder.

findings.evidence: After Ben: selam, a dated Ayşe gruptan ayrıldı system line becomes part of Ben message text.
findings.cause: Every nonmatching nonempty line is treated as continuation of the last message.

findings.evidence: Two entries with distinct from_id user1/user2 but from Ben produce one sender choice; filtering Ben selects both.
findings.cause: Parser discards stable sender identifiers; selection groups only by display name.

evidence: Display name İş: Ayşe is parsed as İş; remainder enters message body.
Timestamp with narrow no-break space before PM produces sender PM] Ayşe.
findings.limitation: Synthetic boundary formats, not a prevalence claim about current WhatsApp exports.

findings.evidence: ankara'da buluşalım learns next word buluşalım; ankara’da buluşalım does not. ASCII e-posta and nonbreaking-hyphen e‑posta show the same difference.
findings.cause: isWord admits ASCII apostrophe/hyphen only; curly/nonbreaking variants are routed to recall instead.

findings.evidence: Existing QRmenü merged with newly observed qrmenü keeps QRmenü as surface.
findings.cause: merge increases count and sequence but does not copy the new Stat.surface; differs from documented last-seen spelling behavior.

controls: Supported multiline WhatsApp fixture correctly produces two messages.
Straight apostrophe and ASCII hyphen learn next-word pairs.
